```js {code-line-numbers="1|2-3|4"}
const values = [2, 4, 6, 8];
const scaled = values.map((x) => x / 2);
const avg = scaled.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / scaled.length;
console.log(avg);
```

```{python}
#| echo: true
#| output: true
#| code-line-numbers: "1|2-3|4"
values = [2, 4, 6, 8]
scaled = [x / 2 for x in values]
avg = sum(scaled) / len(scaled)
avg
```
